entries.en: to eat; to gnaw
to gnaw a bone
to beg; to ask, to request
entries.notes: M 栏首音 g/q 存疑，据 H「求」与 L rogar/pedir 乞求义定为「求」。

entries.en: to entrust; to ask (someone to act on one's behalf)
entries.notes: [疑:co/co] 为同形存疑标记，无实质分歧；「托」义据 H 与 rogare 推定。

entries.en: to betroth; to engage by formal request; to hire
entries.notes: 「聘」与 rogare 的对应取 17 世纪下聘求亲义，依赖推断。

entries.en: to call; to summon
entries.notes: 字形唍/喚存疑，据音 hey 与 rogare 义定为「唤」。

entries.en: to beg; to implore
entries.notes: 字形夾/央存疑，据 rogare 与音 iang 定为「央（央求）」。

entries.en: to invite; to solicit
to persuade; to urge
to want; to demand, to require
to request earnestly (that someone do something)

entries.zh: 祷告；向天主祈求〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to pray to God
entries.notes: M 栏音写残缺（T99），据 H「禱」与 L rogare a Dios 定义，音证无据，释义存疑。

entries.zh: 祈；祈祷〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to pray (to God); to implore
entries.notes: M 栏短语残缺并夹西语字样（como alo…），据 H「祈」与 L rogare a Dios 定义。

entries.en: to wish; to bless; to pray (for)
entries.notes: M 栏首字 po/ho 存疑，据 H「祝」定祝愿义。

entries.en: to submit; to obey; to be convinced
entries.notes: hoc/hoj 音存疑；「服」与 rogare a Dios 的对应取顺服/信服义，依赖推断。

entries.en: to rely on; to depend (for help)
entries.notes: 字形賴/類存疑，据音 nây 与 rogare pidiendo ayuda 定为「赖」。

entries.en: to entreat earnestly; to beg insistently

entries.zh: 请；邀请（请托）〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: to request; to invite
entries.notes: M 栏含 [疑:cheng/cheñg] 且句末残缺，据 H「請」与 L rogare/conbidar（邀）定「请（邀请）」义。

entries.en: to entreat and entrust; to beg (someone to act)
seat, place; order of rank and precedence
entries.notes: H「位次」与 M 音相合，但与词头 rogare 语义不相应，疑为错置条目，故降置信。
